source: Isolated copies of production databases and real AWS KMS, fresh browser context through SSH tunnel
provenance_notes: These are individual diagnostic runs, not percentile measurements or production network SLA.
The prior multi-minute wait was not reproduced.
The isolated server used copied authentication/content/billing databases, production encryption context, no background jobs, and no email or Stripe credentials.
changes: Cloud-first library starts documents and eager tag/member loading without a redundant account-status round trip.
Document request is issued before the independent filter requests.
Browsing uses authorized document rows and encrypted page metadata without requiring text-index readiness.
Permission, revision, subscription and key-version rechecks remain in place.

pricing.homepage: Existing locale-dependent pricing matches the configured currency options; no price or homepage copy change.
